title: Purple Fox Warrior
description: A female anthropomorphic fox character with purple hair and ears leaps dynamically through the air above crumbling stone ruins. She wields a large glowing blue magical sword while casting a pink magical orb and heart symbol toward a massive cracked green spherical structure in the background.
prompt: A fierce anthropomorphic fox girl with long flowing purple hair and fox ears, wearing white and orange battle armor, leaping through the air above destroyed ancient stone ruins. She holds a large translucent blue magical sword with both hands, surrounded by swirling energy and floating blue spirit creatures. Her other hand casts a glowing pink magical orb and heart symbol toward a giant cracked green spherical monument in the background. Dramatic sunset sky with orange and pink clouds, flying debris and broken pillars, cinematic fantasy style, highly detailed digital artwork.
